text: 【港股IPO：基汇资本房地产私募债务开放式基金型公司递表港交所】利弗莫尔证券显示，基汇资本房地产私募债务开放式基金型公司向港交所提交上市申请书，独家保荐人为Jefferies。
text_en: [Hong Kong Stock IPO: Gaw Capital Real Estate Private Debt Open-Ended Fund Company Files with HKEX] According to Livermore Securities, Gaw Capital Real Estate Private Debt Open-Ended Fund Company has submitted an application for listing to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, with Jefferies as sole sponsor.
